subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e escrever palavras com correspondências regulares contextuais entre grafemas e fonemas – c/qu; g/gu; r/rr; s/ss; o (e não u) e e (e não i) em sílaba átona em final de palavra – e com marcas de nasalidade (til, m, n).

components.description_pt: Aplicar correspondências dependentes de contexto para c/qu e g/gu na leitura e escrita
components.description_en: Apply context-dependent correspondences for c/qu and g/gu in reading and writing
components.cc_component_description: Decode words by applying spelling-sound correspondences for consonant digraphs

components.description_pt: Escrever sílabas finais átonas usando o (não u) e e (não i) corretamente
components.description_en: Write unstressed final syllables using o (not u) and e (not i) correctly
components.cc_component_description: Generalize vowel or consonant spelling patterns to write new words correctly

components.description_pt: Ler e escrever palavras com marcadores de nasalidade incluindo til, m e n
components.description_en: Read and write words with nasality markers including tilde, m, and n
components.cc_component_description: Decode words with common vowel teams and other vowel patterns

cc_matches.description: Generalize learned spelling patterns when writing words (e.g., cage → badge; boy → boil).
Know the spelling-sound correspondences for common consonant digraphs.
Know and apply grade-level phonics and word analysis skills in decoding words.
